title: Concept: Gem pinned to a branch
description: Gemfile declares a gem from git whose ref is a branch name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a gem from git whose ref is a branch name.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a gem from git whose ref is a branch name.
